svg.title: TIR-Bench visual reasoning task gallery
svg.desc: 13 tasks and 1,215 examples. Original benchmark input images are preserved as exact raster crops, surrounded by native vector typography and framing. Each card shows its task, sample count, prompt, original image and answer.
